cancellationtokensource-tryreset.title: Reuse a CancellationTokenSource conditionally with TryReset
cancellationtokensource-tryreset.short: Reset an eligible CTS before the next operation
cancellationtokensource-tryreset.summary: TryReset returns true only when a CancellationTokenSource can be reset for another operation.
cancellationtokensource-tryreset.why: Hot paths may reduce CTS allocations, but reuse must respect registrations and concurrent use.
cancellationtokensource-tryreset.tips: Measure before pooling this state, and create a new CTS whenever TryReset returns false.

filestreamoptions-preallocation.title: Preallocate file space with FileStreamOptions.PreallocationSize
filestreamoptions-preallocation.short: Reserve space up front when the expected output size is known
filestreamoptions-preallocation.summary: PreallocationSize asks FileStream creation to reserve storage for an expected file size.
filestreamoptions-preallocation.why: Large sequential writes may avoid some fragmentation and repeated storage growth.
filestreamoptions-preallocation.tips: It does not set the logical file length; treat it as an allocation request rather than file content.

pipewriter-getspan-advance.title: Write directly with PipeWriter.GetSpan and Advance
pipewriter-getspan-advance.short: Fill PipeWriter-owned memory without an intermediate array
pipewriter-getspan-advance.summary: GetSpan obtains writable memory, Advance reports how many bytes were written, and FlushAsync makes them available downstream.
pipewriter-getspan-advance.why: High-throughput protocols and parsers can reduce copying and temporary allocations.
pipewriter-getspan-advance.tips: Advance only the bytes you actually initialized and handle the FlushAsync result correctly.

stream-readatleast-async.title: Read a minimum byte count with Stream.ReadAtLeastAsync
stream-readatleast-async.short: Do not assume one Read returns the requested amount
stream-readatleast-async.summary: ReadAtLeastAsync keeps reading asynchronously until the requested minimum byte count is reached or the stream ends.
stream-readatleast-async.why: Network and compression streams may return short reads, so the API replaces a common manual loop.
stream-readatleast-async.tips: Choose throwOnEndOfStream according to whether an early end is exceptional for your format.

jsonserializeroptions-resolver-chain.title: Compose JSON metadata with TypeInfoResolverChain
jsonserializeroptions-resolver-chain.short: Order generated and custom type-info resolvers explicitly
jsonserializeroptions-resolver-chain.summary: TypeInfoResolverChain manages the ordered resolvers JsonSerializerOptions uses to obtain serialization metadata.
jsonserializeroptions-resolver-chain.why: Source-generated metadata and additional resolvers can be composed incrementally in one options instance.
jsonserializeroptions-resolver-chain.tips: Earlier resolvers have priority, so define the order deliberately when multiple resolvers can handle a type.

enum-isdefined-generic.title: Validate enum values with generic Enum.IsDefined
enum-isdefined-generic.short: Check whether a value is a declared enum member
enum-isdefined-generic.summary: The generic Enum.IsDefined overload reports whether an enum value is explicitly defined by the enum type.
enum-isdefined-generic.why: Values originating from integers or external input can inhabit an enum type without naming a declared member.
enum-isdefined-generic.tips: Flags enums need different validation because valid combinations are often not individually declared values.

exception-throwif-null-empty.title: Validate string arguments with ThrowIfNullOrEmpty and ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace
exception-throwif-null-empty.short: Express common string guards without boilerplate branches
exception-throwif-null-empty.summary: ArgumentException throw helpers reject null, empty, or whitespace-only string arguments with compact guard calls.
exception-throwif-null-empty.why: They state common argument contracts directly without repeating branches and exception construction.
exception-throwif-null-empty.tips: Use only the guard that matches the API contract; an empty string can be a legitimate value.

task-whenall-results-order.title: Task.WhenAll results preserve input order
task-whenall-results-order.short: Receive results in task-list order rather than completion order
task-whenall-results-order.summary: Task.WhenAll<T> returns a result array corresponding to the order of the input tasks, regardless of which task finishes first.
task-whenall-results-order.why: Work can run concurrently while positional correspondence between inputs and outputs remains intact.
task-whenall-results-order.tips: Use a completion-order API such as WhenEach when results should be handled as soon as each task finishes.

memoryextensions-trim-span.title: Trim spans without creating substrings
memoryextensions-trim-span.short: Narrow a ReadOnlySpan<char> to its non-whitespace range
memoryextensions-trim-span.summary: MemoryExtensions.Trim returns the trimmed range of a Span or ReadOnlySpan without constructing a new string.
memoryextensions-trim-span.why: Parsers can keep referring to the original buffer while removing surrounding whitespace logically.
memoryextensions-trim-span.tips: The returned span still refers to the source storage and cannot outlive it.

uri-trycreate.title: Validate URI input without exceptions using Uri.TryCreate
uri-trycreate.short: Treat URI parsing failure as an ordinary branch
uri-trycreate.summary: Uri.TryCreate parses according to a requested UriKind and returns a Uri only on success.
uri-trycreate.why: User input can fail normally without using exceptions for control flow.
uri-trycreate.tips: A syntactically valid URI is not automatically a safe destination; validate schemes and hosts for security-sensitive use.
